question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Honest
solution:
The correct answer is 'Sincere'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Honest is an adjective which means free of deceit; truthful and sincere.
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Secretive - (of a person or an organization) inclined to conceal feelings and intentions or not to disclose information. (अपने विचारों, भावनाओं, कार्यों आदि को छिपाने की प्रवृत्ति या पसंद करना)
 
• Sincere - free from pretense or deceit; proceeding from genuine feelings. (ढोंग या छल से मुक्त; वास्तविक भावनाओं से आगे बढ़ना)
 
• Strange - unusual or surprising; difficult to understand or explain. (असामान्य या आश्चर्यजनक)
 
• Daring - (of a person or action) adventurous or audaciously bold. (ऐसे काम करने का साहस जो खतरनाक हो सकता है)
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that sincere is the correct synonym for the word honest.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.
